recordedBy: hand-written synthetic fixture (packages/desktop_webview); not recorded from the live site
notes: Synthetic responses for replaying MangaFire's challenge solver page (assets/solver.html from the committed all.mangafire 1.6.38 JAR) offline. No challenge fired when the real captures were recorded, so these bodies are invented: generate() reports three shapes, which makes every solve attempt throw, so the page finishes with bridge.postMessage('false') without needing OpenCV. They exercise the browser path (loadData with base URL, user agent, page-start script, window.bridge.postMessage fallback, relative fetches, request headers), not the real captcha.
